title: Vehicle benchmarking and performance targets
outcome: A defensible set of off-road targets and architecture tradeoffs supported by benchmark evidence.
now: Build the off-road benchmark set and convert evidence into measurable targets.
contribution: Research one comparison vehicle, document a source, or improve one measurable requirement.
senior_design_boundary: EcoCAR owns competition targets and architecture decisions; shared academic analysis keeps its separate faculty-approved scope and acceptance.

title: CAD workflow and rear eAxle packaging
outcome: A controlled NX workflow, usable mass budget, and packaging evidence that can support all candidate architectures.
now: Validate NX access, document the eight-step CAD workflow, and benchmark rear eAxle packaging.
contribution: Complete the NX setup, release a practice part, or write and cold-test one workflow check.
senior_design_boundary: Training parts and shared packaging evidence are reusable; ownership of a Senior Design component remains with its academic team.

title: Virtual vehicle and embedded controls toolchain
outcome: A reproducible virtual-vehicle workflow and validated MATLAB/Simulink + TI C2000 development environment.
now: Complete the onramp cohort, confirm the toolchain, and prepare repeatable training runs.
contribution: Finish an Onramp, validate a tool installation, reproduce one model run, or improve one instruction.
senior_design_boundary: Tool training and reproducibility evidence may be shared; control-design decisions follow the approved EcoCAR and academic ownership boundaries.

title: Battery targets and module packaging
outcome: Traceable battery performance targets and a safe, evidence-based cell/module packaging concept.
now: Establish the NX cohort, review sponsored cell information, and prepare calculation checks.
contribution: Audit one calculation chain, organize a cell-spec reference, or create a training-only packaging model.
senior_design_boundary: New members verify inputs and evidence; battery architecture and energized work remain with authorized owners and safety controls.

title: Integrated plan, deliverables, and team operations
outcome: One trustworthy execution system connecting official requirements, owners, dates, decisions, risks, and evidence.
now: Confirm role ownership, maintain the integrated schedule, and prepare upcoming deliverable gates.
contribution: Validate one deliverable card, update one status, log one decision, or improve onboarding documentation.
senior_design_boundary: The system coordinates interfaces and evidence; it does not replace Senior Design schedules, grading, or faculty acceptance.

title: Team identity, outreach, and customer discovery
outcome: A consistent public identity and evidence-based customer/business portfolio that meets program commitments.
now: Name a MarCom owner, complete identity gates, prepare website content, and begin customer-discovery work.
contribution: Draft a consented spotlight, organize approved assets, summarize one interview, or verify a public deliverable.
senior_design_boundary: Public storytelling and discovery can feature academic work only with owner consent, accurate credit, and approved public-safe information.
